Switchgear
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists 
the minor maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed every six years as 
indicated by Y6 in the above title block.
Technical Specification
Item
GIS 220 
 KV
GIS 66 
 KV.
The first draft initiated by eng. Abd Allah Alsayed Mohamed 
Alsyed, tested at 25 Jan 2004, accepted by 
general director eng. Alsyed Atiah Abd Almaqsoud, and 
revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Adel Abdel Qader Mohamed Alnagar, approved by Head Sector of Talkha PS eng. Awad Soliman, and 
certified by EDEPC Quality 
Control Head Sector eng. Aly Al Lethy.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, 
the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,
Wear your safety helmet, 
 safety shoes .... etc
The circuit breaker under 
test must be out of service.
Circuit breaker must be isolated & proper earthing at the two sides of CB.
Isolate control circuit (DC voltage)
Change remote/local switch to local position.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet & safety shoes
Pressure gauge with its 
 delivered connection
20 micron filter
Portable air blower, SF6 gas detector, buzzer,
Screw driver, and set of common keys.
Work to be Carried Out
Put the 
 circuit breaker in open position.
Reduce 
 the oil pressure to 0 bar by using the pressure controller.
Empty the 
 main tank by using the pressure controller.
Clean the 
 bottom of the tank with a solvent.
Bleed the 
 operating mechanism.
Replace 
 the oil filter and charge the operating mechanism with oil.
Place the 
 CB back into normal operation condition.
